extraction_notes: Curve points are manually digitized readings from usable plots; no interpolation between source points was used.
All plotted PNP voltage and current axes retain the datasheet's negative polarity. Curve axes in mA and pF were converted to SI units A and F.
Fig. 1 provides static output characteristics at TA = 25 degC for IB = -80, -160, -240, -320, -400, -480, -560, -640, -720, and -800 uA; the extracted curve is the -800 uA trace.
The electrical-characteristics table gives hFE as guaranteed minimum/maximum bounds. The -0.15 A row is represented by separate minimum and maximum entries, not as a typical value.
The hFE classification table lists rank L = 100-200 and rank H = 200-300 without a stated test condition; it was not used as a fitted point.

No tabulated Cobo or Cibo values are present. Cobo and Cibo are digitized from Fig. 6 at the stated reverse-voltage points; the graph states f = 1 MHz and TA = 25 degC but does not state IE or IC test termination conditions.
Maximum ratings on p. 1 include VCBO = -60 V, VCEO = -60 V, VEBO = -5.0 V, IC = -0.6 A, and PC = 0.25 W at TA = 25 degC. The strict schema exposes VCEO only.
Other p. 2 electrical limits are ICBO max -20 nA at VCB = -50 V, IE = 0; ICEX max -50 nA at VCE = -30 V, VBE(off) = -0.5 V; and IEBO max -10 nA at VEB = -3 V, IC = 0.
Switching maxima on p. 2 are td = 10 ns and tr = 25 ns at VCC = -30 V, IC = -0.15 A, IB1 = -0.015 A; ts = 225 ns and tf = 60 ns at VCC = -6 V, IC = -0.15 A, IB1 = IB2 = -0.015 A.
Early voltage is not tabulated; the output-characteristic plot is a usable output curve but does not provide a directly specified VAF value.
